I agree to 15 tons this month. That completes everyone’s conditional agreement, so our quota is 15 each—not a standing commitment for future months.

I also support resetting the quota after we see the actual stock and discussing any breach without retaliatory overfishing. If we start next month with only 50 tons, I’d favor a more cautious recovery plan rather than automatically taking 9 each and leaving just 5. Protecting future income matters more than squeezing out the largest possible catch every month.
